# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Glyph image correctness**

## Highlights

Upcoming servicing fixes harden mask-filtered glyph images against changes between font-scaler loads. The native corrections retain Skia m158, existing package versions and the managed API.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Filtered glyphs respect regenerated formats and buffer layout** — Rendering follows the reloaded glyph's path rather than stale properties. Incompatible and sub-byte masks are cleared instead of copied, and clipped embossed masks use full plane strides, preventing buffer overwrites, format assertions and corrupted or uncleared mask planes. ([#5739](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5739))
